notes.title: Update 0.0.6.1
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the Proximity Mines evolution where enemies may lose permanently the behaviour of following the player. 
When this happened to the boss they may end up leaving the arena and making the game unwinnable.

notes.title: Demo v0.0.6.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are going to participate in the Steam Next Fest and to celebrate we brought the HEAT!!!

If you are finding the game too easy and winning too much, now you have the option to increse the intensity. There will be More enemies and they will be Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger


When you feel ready now you can select an Anomaly to change the way you play the game.

Late To The Party - You arrived late and the orbital bombardment already started
Lethal Environment - Receive damage continously but the enemies drop extra HP items.
Jammed Weapon - Your Main Weapon is Jammed but you get more weapons.
MORE!!!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/795a007800026ce3eadd6cc8b93f83ac1db21a24.gif


Wishlisting our game is the best way to support us right now, it helps us get visibility on steam and will make steam let you know when we release the game.

If you want to stay updated on what we are doing with the game, please follow the game and us on steam.

Your thoughts matter to us! Share your experiences, likes, dislikes, and any issues by filling out our feedback form.


Thanks a lot for playing the DEMO!!!

notes.title: Demo v0.0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A favorite among our community and a prominent figure in our Main Menu, She has been a highly requested addition.

We want to welcome our newest Agent "The Hare"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/ab5298aaebca296740d84d990659625af8b6993f.gif

After some intense training, we were able to unleash our Agents active skills. Now each Agent will bring its own unique ability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/c5adc5472d4b753d752ca4be4f19e76867de824f.gif

Checking the armory behind a rusty crate we found the awesome Akimbo Pistols which will let you practice your Gun Kata.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44293707/22fad5c08bc2a2f9c1a38e338257bf5bfae45baf.gif

Using all your feedback and seeing how people played the game we adjusted the balance of the game and the player progression, right now we feel the pacing is much better and will give you a better experience.

In order to bring you the best possible experience, we have to reset your savegame.
This will help us greatly to reduce possible errors as we're still under development.
Thank you for understanding and we hope that improvements that we made make you enjoy our game even more.

notes.title: Demo v0.0.3 Update
notes.content:
We added auto-aim for the main weapons as an optional feature.

You can select manual or auto aim when starting a run, or by changing it via options.
You can also toggle auto aim while playing by using the Tab key, or the Right Shoulder via gamepad.

If you have auto-aim enabled, you can still manually aim by pressing the mouse left click and it will start auto aiming again when you release, and using the gamepad if you aim with the right stick it will use your manual aim and return to auto aim on release.

We received a request to have an option to turn off Screen Shake and we added that to the options menu.

We added instructions for playing with gamepad, and now the instructions are visible on the pause screen as well.

Wishlisting our game is the best way to support us right now, it helps us get visibility on steam and will make steam let you know when we release the game.
